title_zh: v205：势函数正规方程缓存复现稠密 full-DCT K1，并显著缩小保留状态
title_en: v205: a potential-normal cache reproduces dense full-DCT K1 with a much smaller retained state
scope_zh: 仅限历史上已经暴露的 p14 开发轨迹、13 套标定、101 帧以及封存的五/九相机结果；不是 fresh、blind、validation 或 test。
scope_en: Limited to the historically exposed p14 development trajectory, 13 calibrations, 101 frames, and sealed five/all-nine-camera results; this is not fresh, blind, validation, or test evidence.

representation.description_zh: 把零均值探测器位移积分为势函数，经一次精确伴随提升到三维场，再在固定非直流 DCT 基中求解封存的正规方程 Cholesky 因子；在线不再保留或扫描稠密响应矩阵。
representation.description_en: Zero-mean detector displacement is integrated into a potential, lifted to the 3D field by one exact adjoint, and solved in the fixed non-DC DCT basis using a sealed normal-equation Cholesky factor; the dense response matrix is no longer retained or scanned online.

interpretation_zh: v205 证明 v204 的稠密响应缓存不是复现 full-DCT K1 所必需的：固定势函数正规方程缓存以约 5.69 倍和 10.25 倍更少的保留标量，在五/九相机的 2626 个单元上把坐标和物理场复现到约 1e-12。九相机准确率仍为 1313/1313、13/13；五相机仍只有 1268/1313、3/13，因此没有建立全可变相机数成功。
interpretation_en: v205 shows that the dense response cache from v204 is not required to reproduce full-DCT K1. A fixed potential-normal cache retains about 5.69x and 10.25x fewer scalar values and reproduces coordinates and physical fields to about 1e-12 across 2,626 five/all-nine-camera cells. All-nine accuracy remains 1,313/1,313 and 13/13, whereas five-camera accuracy remains only 1,268/1,313 and 3/13, so variable-cardinality success has not been established.
decision_boundary_zh: 紧凑路径的 K1 总账为 2A+2A^T，比稠密 K1 多一次 A^T；正式 setup 仍会瞬时构造响应矩阵。本轮没有 fresh wall/RSS、整流水线峰值内存、独立公开工况或真实 BOST 证据。因此只能称开发集上的紧凑表示/缓存 headroom，不能称速度、资源收益、部署算法或算法突破。
decision_boundary_en: Compact K1 has a 2A+2AT total ledger, one AT above dense K1, and formal setup still constructs the response matrix transiently. This run contains no fresh wall/RSS, whole-pipeline peak-memory, independent public-condition, or real-BOST evidence. It therefore establishes compact representation/cache headroom only on an exposed development condition, not speed, resource savings, deployment, or an algorithmic breakthrough.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 结果前冻结一次 fresh-process 资源审计：先移除 setup 的瞬时稠密响应，保留相机换序等变、原生支持可变相机数的接口但不声称所有基数已过门；把 setup 纳入 worker，保留便宜 CPU 对照，并显式测紧凑 K1、稠密 K1 与 K2 的端到端 wall、worker/process-tree RSS 和整流水线峰值。任何资源门失败都不得只凭缓存计数宣称加速。
next_scientific_gate_en: Preregister one fresh-process resource audit: first remove the transient dense setup response and preserve the camera-permutation-equivariant, variable-cardinality interface without claiming that every cardinality passes; place setup inside the worker, retain cheap CPU controls, and measure end-to-end wall time, worker/process-tree RSS, and whole-pipeline peak memory for compact K1, dense K1, and K2. If any resource gate fails, cache counts alone cannot support a speedup claim.
